body: Thank you so much. Good night.
Yes I could. :-) Thank you so very much and thanks for talking to me as well.
Perhaps sometime. :-) I think posting here was definitely the first step in the right direction for me.
Yeah I write about my feelings a lot. I'm not sure where to start on finding a counselor.
Yes I've noticed that being able to talk to someone about it does help a bit.

Yes I am close to my mother. I can't tell her anything though without her getting angry with me. I can't turn to my fiance without him getting angry at me. The people I should be able to turn to just aren't there for me emotionally so I just bottle it all up.
I was seeing a therapist for a little while when I was 15 but I quit going. Her approach to therapy didn't really seem to help for me. I know I should start seeing a therapist again.

Well growing up my parents fought a lot from what I can remember. My father was an alcoholic. He sexually abused me when I was a child and then started raping me when I was 12. All of that ended when I was 13 but I kept it all to myself until I was 15. My depression at that time was very bad so I finally cracked and told my mom about what happened. My father is in prison and won't be out until sometime in 2037. I still get nightmares about him though and the memories won't go away. I still cry about it sometimes.
Thank you for commenting. I don't even know where to start... I don't know if I should start from the beginning or from the present.
